FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity?

Our MOQ starts at approximately 50 pieces. The suitable quantity can vary depending on the printing requirement.

Do you print on cut panels as well as finished garments?

Yes. We print on cut garment panels before stitching as well as ready-made and finished garments.

Can you help us choose the right printing method?

Yes. We can discuss the garment, artwork and intended result and help determine a suitable approach.

Can I see a sample before placing a bulk order?

Yes. Paid sampling is available so you can review the actual print before approving bulk production.

Can I order different garment sizes together?

Yes. Mixed sizes can be included when garments or panels are properly sorted.

How long does production usually take?

Normal production turnaround is approximately 2–4 weeks, depending on workload and order requirements.
